'''[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] VenHalgon''' was the wife of the aristocrat [[Sargo VenHalgon]] and she lived with him in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they went on vacation to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and stayed aboard the [[Cularin Star Tours]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Twilight's Kiss]]''. Her husband landed it in the jungle on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and went off hunting along with [[Minister]] [[Cannison (Minister)|Cannison]] and [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Worrita (Professor)|Worrita]]. After they failed to return, VenHalgon went off to look for them, along with [[Mrs. Cannison]] and [[Worrita (Mrs)|Mrs. Worrita]]. They also got lost, but were found by some [[Tarasin]]. They took the women to where their husbands were and VenHalgon berated her husband for leaving the ship so ill-prepared.
